observations: Source white flat dogbone with wider ends, two clamps, extensometer bars and wires partly occluding the specimen.
Several transverse crack lines in the reduced section are visible by10s and become more apparent at25/40/53s.
Source captions/annotations obstruct some inspection; original sheet calls the video abnormal.
No observed source frame unambiguously proves two fully separated pieces or a measured brittle rupture instant.
Candidate has small loading and progressive fracture opening; front-facing view exposes background through most of the opening; the last tiny rear contact patch is unbonded after final cut.
assumptions: User-confirmed ceramic identity; composition/grade/porosity and source reinforcement state unknown.
This is a qualitative monolithic ceramic brittle demonstration extended beyond the source gradual crack stage; no source-verified complete rupture time or calibrated stress/strain claimed.
Mildly irregular transverse fracture surface and front-to-rear/lateral propagation are authored geometry; true source through-thickness crack path unknown.
Prefracture nominal free-span elastic-like extension0.24%, extra continuous grip travel0.028 and total grip travel0.040 are relative demonstration parameters.

Continuous crack opening under loading occurs with a finite residual ligament; upper material displacement varies through the thickness and along the material, rather than instant full-fragment translation at the cut.
Final separation is a topological cut of the last ligament with unchanged unique material vertex coordinates, unchanged fixture positions and unchanged same-material front/rear boundary lengths.

Tiny rear central complementary surface patch remains in zero-opening unbonded geometric contact after complete fracture. Coordinate welding would falsely bond this contact; actual evaluated mesh indices/edge graph are used.

No material removed; complete fragments never shorten, translate, rotate or oscillate after separation. Local pre-separation ligament deformation/unloading is only a geometric approximation, not a calibrated ceramic strain field.
Selected stop condition freezes specimen and fixtures from481; source controller delay/moving end unresolved.
Visible simplified machine load train, with source extensometer and annotations omitted for readability.
Small material-volume variation before final separation represents an uncalibrated elastic-like/local crack-zone geometric change; ceramic incompressibility is not asserted.
unknowns: Ceramic grade/composition/porosity, tensile strength, modulus and fracture toughness.
Source actual loading/fixed end and control-response delay; candidate upper loading/lower fixed is a selected demonstration condition.
Formal source gauge and physical dimensions; no mm dimensions or standard compliance asserted.
Source exact fracture mode, complete-separation time, crack front through thickness and true 3D fracture surface.
General mesh self intersection is not exhaustively solved; seam nonpenetration measured only on complementary matched faces.
No force equilibrium, stress field, contact pressure or constitutive calibration.
